InventoryMovements.title: Inventory movements
InventoryMovements.body:
Every stock movement in this workspace appears here as an entry in a running movement journal. On-hand is computed from the movements, never kept as a separate figure.

Pick an item on the left: the right pane shows its on-hand quantity, the negative-stock policy and the history with running balance, quantity, unit cost, location and lot or serial number.

You record new movements and transfers through the two forms. Existing entries are never rewritten.
